portal_description:
The NetworkManager-libreswan package contains software for integrating the
libreswan VPN software with NetworkManager and the GNOME desktop.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Implement `rightcert` Support in NetworkManager-libreswan [rhel-9.2.0.z] (JIRA:RHEL-33370)

* [RFE] Support `leftsubnet` in IPSec configuration in NM-libreswan [rhel-9.2.0.z] (JIRA:RHEL-33374)
